name: NAV-023 search normalisation test vectors
story: NAV-023 AC 2, AC 3 (shared by the search DB builder tests and the Android on-device engine tests)
owner: backend-engineer (backend/pack/vectors/); readers: backend/pack/tests/test_search_builder.py, mobile/android engine unit tests
change_rule: Append-only within a vectors_version. A change to the NAV-023 AC 2 rules or to an expected value is a change to NAV-023 (through the BA): bump vectors_version (new file search-normalisation.v<N>.json) and, when stored keys change, search_schema.

rules.clean: Remove Traditional Mongolian script U+1800-U+18AF and U+202F (each run replaced by one space), collapse whitespace runs to one space, trim (NAV-003 AC 18). Applied to every stored or displayed string before fold/skeleton.
rules.fold: Lower case (Unicode, locale-independent), then ү -> у, ө -> о, ё -> е (NAV-023 Terms).
skeleton: 1. fold, then Unicode NFD and drop every combining mark (Latin diacritics: ü -> u, ö -> o; this also turns й into и, which step 2 maps to i either way)

2. map Cyrillic: а a, б b, в v, г g, д d, е e, ж j, з z, и i, й i, к k, л l, м m, н n, о o, п p, р r, с s, т t, у u, ф f, х h, ц c, ч ch, ш sh, щ sh, ы i, э e, ю yu, я ya; ь and ъ dropped; every other character kept as is
3. on the result, in this order: kh -> h, ts -> c, zh -> j, then y -> i (each a global left-to-right replace)

4. collapse every run of the same letter a-z to one letter (digits are not collapsed), THEN drop every character other than a-z, 0-9 and space; finally collapse spaces and trim. The order is pinned by vector K02 (Баян-Нуур -> baiannur)
rules.words: Split on every run of characters that are not a Unicode letter, digit or underscore (Python \w, re.UNICODE); empty parts dropped. Used for the joined-word keys and for the name tokens of a query.
rules.joined_pairs: Each pair of adjacent words concatenated without the separator (the builder stores these for folded words and for skeleton words).

skeleton_distinct.note: Latin u for ө: the skeleton does NOT join them (NAV-020 task §3.6). Query-side variants must cover it (ADR-0012 / NAV-023 SM3 step 3); open request to the BA for an AC 3 group or a statement.
joined-word key enhtaivani is stored; enhtaivni is 1 edit from it (edit-distance expansion, AC 6)
